title: Microregion model fidelity & procurement signal scout
creator: Sofia Alvarez
description: Run a targeted scout to measure model fidelity (quality vs latency) across microregions (APAC east, APAC south, EMEA secondary) and translate signals into procurement readiness triggers. Goal: create a lightweight decision surface that indicates when a regional model variant should be promoted to 'fallback-ready' or when reserved capacity should be provisioned. This ticket scopes instrumentation, synthetic workload design, signal weighting, and a prototype alert rule for procurement/Sales Ops.
success_criteria: 1) Collect representative telemetry for three microregions across 5 workload archetypes within two weeks. 2) Produce a ranked procurement-signal score per region that aligns with field evidence from two sales conversations. 3) Prototype alert rules and a short runbook for triggering vendor conversations or Dedicated capacity commitments.
acceptance_criteria: - Telemetry dashboard with regional breakdown (latency P50/P95, token cost, top-3 quality regressions) is available. - A documented scoring heuristic and example of 3 synthetic workload samples used in tests. - Alert rule (thresholds + playbook) checked in to the signal-hub repo with unit tests.
tasks: Design synthetic workload templates for intent-heavy, short-context, and long-context workflows
Instrument per-region query sampling and KV cache hit tagging (collab with ENG telemetry)
Define signal weighting (latency cost vs quality delta) and implement scoring script
Run 48hr scout in APAC-east, APAC-south, EMEA-secondary; collect and store results
Draft procurement trigger thresholds and handoff runbook for Solutions/Sales Ops
comments: 2025-02-11 Sofia Alvarez: Kickoff meeting notes posted to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xyz_example. Agreed scope: 3 regions, 5 archetypes, 48hr rolling runs.

2025-02-17 Product review: PMs requested sensitivity runs for weight combinations (focus on worst-case for regulated customers). Action: add two sensitivity scenarios and rerun.
